articles.summary: Delivered record third quarter performance with significant year-over-year growth Raising guidance for full year 2025 growth based on exceptional third quarter results Proven Refresh, Build, Buy strategy continues driving growth with a meaningful pipeline to accelerate Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (“Pursuit”) (NYSE: PRSU) today reported results for the third quarter 2025 and raised guidance for the full year 2025. David Barry, Pursuit’s President and Chief Executive Officer, commented, “We delivered record third quarter results with strong revenue growth compared to the prior year across all geographies, including exceptionally strong growth from Jasper's recovery, paired with margin expansion from the strong operating leverage in the business and our continued cost discipline. articles.title: Pursuit Reports 2025 Third Quarter Results
